plan: Ensure audit process concludes with an 'approve' verdict
Update all relevant documentation to reflect changes in the software release
Obtain a sign-off from the responsible human authority
If the release succeeds, verify that it goes live; if it fails, execute a rollback procedure

steps: Conduct a thorough review of the audit results to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria.
Compile a comprehensive list of all documentation that requires updates and assign updating tasks to relevant team members.
Schedule a meeting with the responsible human authority to present the audit results and updated documentation for sign-off.
After obtaining sign-off, perform a final check to ensure all components are prepared for release.
Proceed with the release process and monitor the system for any issues.
If any critical issues arise during release, initiate the predefined rollback procedure.
Verify the release success by checking system functionality and stakeholder feedback.
If rolled back, diagnose the failure points and start corrective actions before retrying the release.
